attribution.title: High Trestle Trail Bridge
attribution.author: Phil Roeder from Des Moines, IA, USA
attribution.description: I posted some photos of this bridge back in November, before the public art component was installed. The bridge is a half-mile long and 13-stories above the Des Moines River at it's highest point, and is a part of the new 25-mile long High Trestle Trail. This view is from part of an old 1912 railroad bridge, which now provides a viewing platform for the new structure and the river valley.
